popupWelcomeText1:
¡Los vehículos eléctricos molan, y recargarlos también!
Te ayudamos a elegir entre las diferentes tarjetas y aplicaciones de recarga, ¡y te decimos cuál es la mejor opción para ti!
popupWelcomeText2:
No hace falta que te preocupes por los precios por kWh, por minuto o por sesión, ni por cuánto tiempo tardará la recarga.
Nosotros hacemos los cálculos y te mostramos el coste estimado de tu sesión de recarga.

priceListAvgPriceInfo:
There are two modes to display prices:
- Total cost: how much you pay for the whole charging session, based on your vehicle model
- Average price per kWh: based on your charging session, we calculate the cost of kWh, taking into account fees and time based prices.
You can also see unit prices in the price details.
tariffDetailsTotalInfo:
Calculated values incl. 10% charging drain. Actual values depend on vehicle, charging station, weather etc.

Monthly fees are not included.
affiliateDisclosure: Links to providers might be affiliate links, where Chargeprice gets a commission per click. Affiliate partner are not ranked higher. Tariffs are only sorted by prices.
landingWebNoteText: The free web app compares direct payment prices. All tariffs, your wallet, the operator filter and saved routes require Premium in the browser — or use them for free in the mobile app.
